_meta.what_this_is: One decoding step: the model's raw output logits over a tiny 6-token vocabulary, before any softmax. These are the numbers temperature and top-p act on. The vocabulary is toy words so the distribution is readable; the logits are chosen so one token dominates but the tail is not negligible, which is exactly where temperature and nucleus truncation change the outcome.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE standing in for a real model's logits at one position. No model, no forward pass.
